newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-HEARTS CRUSHED BY CHAMPIONS RANGERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-HEARTS CRUSHED BY CHAMPIONS RANGERS.

text.p: A late goal from Paul Gascoigne sealed a 4-1 away win for champions Glasgow Rangers over 10-man Heart of Midlothian in the Scottish premier division on Saturday.
David Robertson, Brian Laudrup and Joerg Albertz with a penalty were Rangers' other scorers in a bad-tempered match at Tynecastle. Albertz also missed a penalty.
Hearts, who had four players sent off in their last league clash against Rangers, again failed to finish with a full team.
Former Everton defender Neil Pointon was sent off on the stroke of halftime after twice clashing with Rangers' Danish striker Erik Bo Andersen.
